#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

mode=${1:-ctx}
if [ "$mode" = "ctx" ]; then
  pick=$(kubectl config get-contexts -o name | fzf --prompt="ctx> ")
  [ -n "$pick" ] && kubectl config use-context "$pick"
elif [ "$mode" = "ns" ]; then
  pick=$(kubectl get ns -o name | sed 's|namespace/||' | fzf --prompt="ns> ")
  [ -n "$pick" ] && kubectl config set-context --current --namespace="$pick"
else
  echo "usage: $0 {ctx|ns}"; exit 1
fi
